topic: Donation tax credit: two tiers; spouses may claim each other's receipts; carry forward 5 years

example.note: example (not a CRA rule): couple, each gave $300 in 2025; federal credit only (14.5% on the first $200, 29% above; the 33% band for top-bracket income not used); the claiming spouse must have enough tax to use a non-refundable credit; provincial credits not included.

sources.rates: 2025 federal: 14.5% on the first $200, 29% above (33% to the extent of top-bracket income): taxtips.ca 2025 rates, KPMG 2025 credit table, KPMG 'make your 2025 donations tax effective' (example $600 → $145)
sources.who: canada.ca line 34900 'Who can claim': your gifts or your spouse's/common-law partner's, official receipts, not already claimed (via search 2026-11-09)
sources.carry: canada.ca line 34900 'How much you can claim': carry forward for any of the next 5 years (10 for ecologically sensitive land); carried-forward gifts claimed first
